info.title: Alignment Economy Node API
info.description: The Alignment Economy protocol node API. Write requests are signed: the body is a { accountId, timestamp, signature, payload } envelope, where signature is an ML-DSA-65 signature over the canonical payload. Amounts are base-unit integer strings (10^8 per point).

timestamp.description: Unix seconds; must be within 5 minutes of server time

signature.description: ML-DSA-65 signature over the canonical payload + timestamp
